preparationHistory: Before any Stock invocation, a local alias-map assembly stopped on a SHA mismatch: four legacy baseline image references had overridden selected current references. The unsealed host was rebuilt with selected-current precedence; all hashes then matched.

The first Stock generation found no landscapes because its unchanged Dirent.isFile discovery does not follow canonical file symlinks. Raw failure is retained.
